title: Paul Accepted by the Apostles, Paul Opposes Peter

questions.question: Then after ____ years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along with me.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:1 (ESV): "Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along with me."

questions.question: Paul went up to Jerusalem because of a ____ and set before them the gospel he proclaimed among the Gentiles, to make sure he was not running in vain.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:2 (ESV): "I went up because of a revelation and set before them (though privately before those who seemed influential) the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles, in order to make sure I was not running or had not run in vain."

questions.question: But even Titus, who was with him, was not forced to be ____, though he was a Greek.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:3 (ESV): "But even Titus, who was with me, was not forced to be circumcised, though he was a Greek."

questions.question: The issue of circumcision arose because of false brothers secretly brought in to spy out their ____ in Christ Jesus, so that they might bring them into slavery.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:4 (ESV): "Yet because of false brothers secretly brought in—who slipped in to spy out our freedom that we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might bring us into slavery—"

questions.question: To these false brothers, Paul "did not yield in submission even for a moment, so that the truth of the ____ might be preserved for you."
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:5 (ESV): "to them we did not yield in submission even for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might be preserved for you."

questions.question: Those who seemed influential saw that Paul had been entrusted with the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been entrusted with the gospel to the ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:7 (ESV): "On the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been entrusted with the gospel to the circumcised"

questions.question: James and Cephas and John, who seemed to be ____, perceived the grace given to Paul and gave the right hand of fellowship to Barnabas and him.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:9 (ESV): "and when James and Cephas and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave the right hand of fellowship to Barnabas and me..."

questions.question: The only thing they asked of Paul and Barnabas was that they remember the ____, the very thing Paul was eager to do.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:10 (ESV): "Only, they asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do."

questions.question: When Cephas (Peter) came to Antioch, Paul opposed him to his face, because he stood ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:11 (ESV): "But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned."

questions.question: Why did Paul oppose Peter in Antioch?
options: Because Peter drew back and separated himself from the Gentiles, fearing the circumcision party
Because Peter began to preach circumcision as necessary for salvation
Because Peter denied the bodily resurrection
Because Peter refused to partake in the Lord's Supper
questions.correctAnswer: Because Peter drew back and separated himself from the Gentiles, fearing the circumcision party
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:12 (ESV): "For before certain men came from James, he was eating with the Gentiles; but when they came he drew back and separated himself, fearing the circumcision party."

questions.question: The rest of the Jews acted hypocritically along with him, so that even ____ was led astray by their hypocrisy.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:13 (ESV): "And the rest of the Jews acted hypocritically along with him, so that even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy."

questions.question: Paul asks Peter: "If you, though a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you force the Gentiles to ____?"
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:14 (ESV): "But when I saw that their conduct was not in step with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before them all, 'If you, though a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you force the Gentiles to live like Jews?'"

questions.question: Yet we know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:16 (ESV): "yet we know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, so we also have believed in Christ Jesus, in order to be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified."

questions.question: Paul writes, "I have been ____ with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me."
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:20 (ESV): "I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me..."

questions.question: I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness were through the law, then Christ died for ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 2:21 (ESV): "I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness were through the law, then Christ died for no purpose."

key_verse_text: I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me. And the life I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
